svg.title: Tableware card: retain the letter before adding a mug cue
svg.desc: Only the middle body changes: the cup silhouette disappears and the native U becomes visible. M, G, handle, sizes, positions, photography, literal MUG label and product information stay fixed. Original fictional design. Photographs previously generated with AI and reused unchanged; expressive typography composed separately with a fixed variable-font weight.
svg.text: BEFORE · A cup symbol substitutes for U
AFTER · U stays readable with a handle
